Documentation section docs/isbn.md#ISBNs > Normalising:

`normalise(raw)` removes spacing and hyphens and upper-cases a trailing `X`, so
that `978-0-441-01359-3` and `9780441013593` are the same key. Pass
`strict=True` to raise `InvalidISBN` rather than return something malformed.

The chunk bookshelf/isbn.py::normalise before the change:

def normalise(raw, strict=False):
    cleaned = raw.translate(_NOISE).upper()
    if strict and (not is_valid(cleaned)):
        raise InvalidISBN(raw)
    return cleaned

And after it:

def normalise(text, strict=False):
    cleaned = text.translate(_NOISE).upper()
    if strict and (not is_valid(cleaned)):
        raise InvalidISBN(text)
    return cleaned
